chunks: "Beware of red camels, for they have the shortest lifespan among camels."

key_terms.إِيَّاكُمْ: beware; a warning directed to the audience
key_terms.الصَّادِقُ: Imam Ja'far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq عليه السلام

ai.seo_question: What did Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام say about red camels?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام warns against choosing red camels, stating that they are the shortest-lived among camels. The report conveys practical guidance based on observed qualities and suitability.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.2483 - Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) said:
"Beware of red camels, for they have the shortest lifespan among camels."
